comments: Ratios are truncated to two decimals and never rounded up; pass/fail uses the unrounded value. Limits are stated on the page (transparency, gradients, background images not accounted for).
features: Free WCAG 2.1 color contrast checker. Tests a text and background color pair against 1.4.3 (AA), 1.4.6 (AAA) and 1.4.11 non-text contrast, plus an optional link-versus-surrounding-text check. Runs in your browser; colors are not uploaded. Checks color pairs you enter, not a whole page.
title: ValleyFill WCAG Color Contrast Checker
